summary: What must happen between an outsider's push and model spend in the untrusted PR gate

options.description: Model job uses a GitHub environment with the maintainer as required reviewer; the API key is an environment secret
Model stage runs only after a maintainer labels the PR; a push removes the label
Every outsider push starts a review, limited by timeouts and caps
First review per PR automatic, later pushes need approval

body: Problem: the gate's model stage bills ANTHROPIC_API_KEY against a 100 USD monthly credit (operator ruling 2026-11-13: sparingly, outsider PRs only). The cost of one review is unmeasured. Axes: spend control, contributor wait, and how much mechanism must be built and trusted.
